name: Hysterectomy for Adenomyosis — Oregon Prioritized List Guideline Note 39

branches.adenomyosis: Hysterectomy indicated by documented adenomyosis (Section B of Guideline Note 39)

criteria.description: Medical necessity for hysterectomy in adenomyosis. ALL of patient history, failed trial, imaging, cytology, and pregnancy-status criteria must be met.

policy_citation.quote: Hysterectomy, with or without adnexectomy, for adenomyosis may be appropriate when all of the following are documented

children.description: Documented patient history of qualifying symptoms with duration and quality-of-life impact.
Patient history of dysmenorrhea, pelvic pain, OR abnormal uterine bleeding for more than six months, with documented negative impact on quality of life.

policy_citation.quote: Patient history of dysmenorrhea, pelvic pain or abnormal uterine bleeding for more than six months with a negative effect on her quality of life

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for Condition codes N94.6 (dysmenorrhea), N93.* (AUB), N91.* (oligomenorrhea/AUB) plus narrative documenting symptom onset date and ADL/QoL impact (work, sleep, intimacy, activity restriction).

verdict_rubric.met: Symptom onset documented >6 months before request AND specific narrative of QoL impact present (e.g., missed work, activity restriction).
verdict_rubric.not_met: Symptom duration <6 months OR symptom history not in qualifying categories.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Duration documented but QoL impact narrative is vague OR vice versa.
verdict_rubric.not_documented: No symptom history of dysmenorrhea, pelvic pain, or AUB in available records.

children.description: Either a completed 6-month trial of hormonal therapy AND NSAIDs, OR documented contraindication to that trial.

policy_citation.quote: Failure of a six-month therapeutic trial with both of the following (a and b), unless there are contraindications to use

children.description: Completed 6-month trial of BOTH hormonal therapy AND NSAIDs.
Trial of hormonal therapy for at least 6 months. Acceptable agents: oral contraceptive pills/patches, progesterone-containing IUDs, injectable hormone therapy, GnRH analogs, danazol.

policy_citation.quote: Hormonal therapy (i or ii): i) Oral contraceptive pills or patches, progesterone-containing IUDs, injectable hormone therapy, or similar ii) Agents for inducing amenorrhea (e.g., GnRH analogs or danazol)

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for OCPs (norethindrone, drospirenone, etc.), levonorgestrel-IUD (e.g., Mirena), DMPA (depot medroxyprogesterone), leuprolide, danazol. Capture start/end dates to validate 6-month duration.

verdict_rubric.met: Hormonal agent from listed classes documented with start and end (or current) dates spanning ≥6 months.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Hormonal trial documented but <6 months total duration.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Hormonal agent documented but dates ambiguous; agent class is borderline (e.g., topical hormones).
verdict_rubric.not_documented: No hormonal therapy in available records.

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for ibuprofen, naproxen, diclofenac, meloxicam, celecoxib, ketorolac, etc. Confirm an active or completed trial concurrent with the hormonal therapy window.

verdict_rubric.met: NSAID (ibuprofen/naproxen/etc.) documented as part of pain management for this condition.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Pain management documented but only with non-NSAID agents (e.g., acetaminophen only).
verdict_rubric.unclear: Generic 'pain reliever' mentioned without identification of class.
verdict_rubric.not_documented: No NSAID or pain medication in available records.

children.description: Documented clinical contraindication to either hormonal therapy or NSAIDs that justifies skipping the 6-month trial.

policy_citation.quote: unless there are contraindications to use

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for AllergyIntolerance to NSAIDs or hormonal agents; Condition history (e.g., active VTE for hormonal contraindication, GI bleed for NSAID contraindication); explicit clinician note that trial is contraindicated.

verdict_rubric.met: Explicit documentation of a specific contraindication to at least one of hormonal or NSAID therapy (e.g., VTE history → no estrogen; active PUD → no NSAID).
verdict_rubric.not_met: No contraindication documented and trial requirement applies.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Patient declined therapy citing 'side effects' without clinician note of contraindication.
verdict_rubric.not_documented: No allergy, comorbidity, or clinician statement addressing contraindication.

children.description: Imaging confirmation of adenomyosis: either suspicious endovaginal ultrasound or MRI junctional zone thickening.

policy_citation.quote: One of the following (a or b)

children.description: Endovaginal ultrasound findings suspicious for adenomyosis (hypoechoic myometrial echogenicity or small myometrial cysts).

policy_citation.quote: Endovaginal ultrasound suspicious for adenomyosis (presence of abnormal hypoechoic myometrial echogenicity or presence of small myometrial cysts)

evaluation.extraction_hints: Find a TVUS/endovaginal ultrasound report describing one of the two characteristic findings.

verdict_rubric.met: TVUS report explicitly describes hypoechoic myometrial echogenicity or small myometrial cysts.
verdict_rubric.not_met: TVUS report is normal or describes a different pathology.
verdict_rubric.unclear: TVUS mentions 'possible adenomyosis' without the specific findings called out.

children.description: MRI showing junctional zone thickening greater than 12 mm.

policy_citation.quote: MRI showing thickening of the junctional zone > 12 mm

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for pelvic MRI report with junctional zone measurement in millimeters.

verdict_rubric.met: MRI report explicitly states junctional zone thickness >12 mm.
verdict_rubric.unclear: MRI describes adenomyosis qualitatively without a numeric junctional zone measurement.
verdict_rubric.not_documented: No pelvic MRI in available records.

children.description: If a cervix is present, cervical cytology must be non-malignant.
Nonmalignant cervical cytology documented if cervix is present (Pap result NILM or benign within recommended interval).

policy_citation.quote: Nonmalignant cervical cytology, if cervix is present

evaluation.extraction_hints: Find Pap smear / liquid-based cervical cytology result. Acceptable: NILM, negative for intraepithelial lesion. If cervix is absent (prior trachelectomy/supracervical hysterectomy), this criterion is automatically met.

verdict_rubric.met: Pap smear NILM/benign documented within standard screening interval; OR cervix is documented as absent.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Pap smear shows HSIL, ASC-H, AGC, or other concerning finding.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Pap result documented but interpretation language ambiguous; OR no date specified.
verdict_rubric.not_documented: No cervical cytology in records and cervix presence not addressed.

children.description: Negative preoperative pregnancy test OR documented postmenopausal status OR documented prior sterilization.

policy_citation.quote: Negative preoperative pregnancy test unless patient is postmenopausal

children.description: Negative preoperative pregnancy test (urine or serum hCG).

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for hCG result, urine or serum, with explicit 'negative' interpretation, dated within 14 days of planned surgery.

verdict_rubric.met: Negative hCG documented within 14 days of planned procedure.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Pregnancy test positive OR dated outside acceptable window.
verdict_rubric.unclear: hCG ordered but result pending; OR test date not clearly within window.
verdict_rubric.not_documented: No pregnancy test in pre-op records.

children.description: Patient is documented as postmenopausal (≥12 months amenorrhea or age >55 with no contraindicating evidence).

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for explicit 'postmenopausal' in problem list, last menstrual period >12 months ago, or FSH >25 IU/L with absent menses.

verdict_rubric.met: Postmenopausal status explicitly documented OR clear inference from LMP/FSH/age.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Patient has documented active menses or is documented as premenopausal.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Age suggestive but menopausal status not addressed.

children.description: Patient has had a prior sterilization procedure (e.g., bilateral tubal ligation, salpingectomy).

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for surgical history of bilateral tubal ligation/Essure/salpingectomy in past procedures.

verdict_rubric.met: Procedure history shows prior tubal ligation, salpingectomy, or equivalent.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Procedure history indicates no prior sterilization.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Patient reports 'tubes tied' but no procedure record available.
verdict_rubric.not_documented: No surgical history reviewed or available.

exclusions.description: Hysterectomy for endometriosis without adenomyosis — covered by Section A criteria (3-month trial), not Section B.

policy_citation.quote: Hysterectomy, with or without adnexectomy, for endometriosis may be appropriate when all of the following are documented

evaluation.extraction_hints: If primary diagnosis is endometriosis (N80.0/N80.1/N80.2/N80.3/N80.8/N80.9) without adenomyosis (N80.03 specifically excluded by hierarchy), Section A criteria apply, not this policy's Section B path.

verdict_rubric.met: Primary diagnosis is endometriosis-only without adenomyosis — exclusion fires (re-route to Section A criteria).
verdict_rubric.not_met: Adenomyosis is documented as the primary indication.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Both adenomyosis and endometriosis documented; clarification needed on primary indication.

metadata.notes: Models Section B (adenomyosis) of Oregon Guideline Note 39. Section A (endometriosis) would be authored as a sibling policy or branch.
